title: LLM Batch Prompt Injector & Dataset Synthesizer
target_pain: Engineers and creators struggle with manually populating prompt templates across large CSV/JSON datasets, converting text into structured LLM API batch payloads (OpenAI JSONL format), and preparing fine-tuning data.
key_features: Instant CSV, TSV & JSON parsing with automatic variable detection
Interactive variable insertion tags for dynamic prompt template drafting
One-click OpenAI Batch API (JSONL), Anthropic, JSON, CSV, and Markdown generator
Built-in data cleaning: deduplication, whitespace stripping, & regex conditional filters
Direct client-side file export (.jsonl, .json, .csv, .txt) with zero server latency
